name: description-list
description:
Term/value pairs on a semantic `<dl>`: `DescriptionList` > `DescriptionItem` > `DescriptionTerm` + `DescriptionDetails`.

- **`layout="inline"`** (default): each value at the end of its row, right-aligned with tabular numbers — for order summaries, totals and plan details.
- **`layout="stacked"`**: the value under a smaller term, in a grid whose columns you set with `className` — for record details.
- **`divided`**: draws rules between rows.
- **Icons**: an icon inside `DescriptionTerm` sits before the label.
